title: And His Name Is John Cena
blurb: AND HIS NAME IS JOHN CENA — trumpet fanfare, then the announcement, then chaos. The clip became the engine of one of the internet's great bait-and-switch pranks: lull someone with something calm, then detonate this at full volume. The joke worked because Cena's entrance is genuinely triumphant, so the interruption always feels like an event rather than just noise. Play it for anything arriving unexpectedly and with maximum force — the delivery driver, the plot twist, a parent entering a room the lights were supposed to be off in.
origin: John Cena's WWE entrance announcement, immortalized by the unexpected-Cena prank meme.
